title: Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth
what_it_is: Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth

sections.label: Heritage plan and UNESCO ratification
sections.summary: Singapore launched the Our SG Heritage Plan and ratified the UNESCO 2003 Convention on Intangible Cultural Heritage on 22 February 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Our culture and heritage are important parts of what make us Singaporean.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This year, we launched the Our SG Heritage Plan, a long-term comprehensive national masterplan to safeguard and promote our shared heritage for future generations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We ratified the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation (UNESCO) 2003 Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage on 22 February 2018.

sections.label: Heritage, arts and employment support
sections.summary: Singapore will change legislation within two years to preserve heritage, support artists, and adopt the Tripartite Standard on Contracting with Self-Employed Persons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This demonstrates Singapore’s commitment to safeguard and promote our heritage, which is important to strengthen our identity as a nation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will also make changes to the relevant legislation within the next two years to better support the preservation of our tangible and intangible heritage, and to safeguard our archaeological history more effectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will continue to enrich and grow our arts scene, and support our artists in areas, such as audience development, community arts, arts education, capability development, internationalisation, as well as research and documentation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will also adopt the Tripartite Standard on Contracting with Self-Employed Persons in the arts and culture sector to promote fair and progressive employment practices.

sections.label: SG Cares volunteering in Bedok and Jurong
sections.summary: SG Cares aims for a volunteer in every household, starting with support to community stakeholders in Bedok and Jurong.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: SG Cares seeks to have a person in every household who volunteers, making the values of care and contribution a norm.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: As a start, we will provide greater support to local community stakeholders in Bedok and Jurong – community partners, religious organisations, schools and merchants in the neighbourhood – to serve the needs of residents and coordinate and mobilise resources.

sections.label: Active Health movement and labs
sections.summary: Active Health was launched to spur Singaporeans to take ownership of health, with four more labs and two Mobile Labs this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To meet the challenges of an ageing society, we launched Active Health, a national social movement to spur Singaporeans to take ownership of their health and wellness and support one another in sustaining an active lifestyle.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To kickstart their Active Health journey, Singaporeans can visit an Active Health Lab to have their baseline health indicators assessed and choose from a wide range of ActiveSG programmes to get active together with family, colleagues and friends.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will roll out four more labs at Bishan, Jurong East, Sengkang and Woodlands Sports Centres, and two Mobile Labs this year.
